checks.residual_satisfiable: I tested whether each of the six fields of GX.AntoineFirstGeneration is true, so the reduction cannot rest on an unsatisfiable premise. `disjoint`: checked numerically over all 64x63 ordered pairs on a dense grid of each link including its corners. The minimum of (max(|x|,|y|)-7/8)^2+z^2 over the other links is 0.125 against the bound 1/16, a margin of sqrt 0.125 = 0.354, which matches the report. Adjacent links are geometrically linked once: each vertical link's inner side crosses the horizontal neighbour's hole at rho in [1/4,1/2]. The 64-link chain alternates types all the way round, corners included, so it is a genuine closed chain and `chain` is the classical first-generation Antoine lemma. Since a link complement has a torsion-free pi_1, every nonzero power is also non-null. `collar_conn`, `collar_mer` (kernel of Z^2 -> Z), `collar_inj` (linking with L_j and L_{j+1} detects Z^2) and `joined` all hold for N_j = a round-square open solid torus, L_j the closed rectangle-section torus inside it (L subset N is proved), and the meridian of radius 3/14 lying strictly between the two (sqrt2/8 < 3/14 < 1/4). checks.vankampen_statements: homotopicIn_of_homotopicIn_union is the standard injectivity consequence of SvK (U, V open, U, V and U∩V path-connected, pi_1(U∩V) injecting into both sides, gives pi_1(U) -> pi_1(U∪V) injective on null-homotopy). The primed form drops path-connectedness of U and V under LocPathConnectedSpace X. That is sound: U0 ∪ V0 is clopen in U ∪ V because (U\U0)∩V0 = ∅ when U∩V is path-connected. Neither statement is vacuous; the hypotheses are the classical ones.

summary: Both files build, and the one sorry is GX.antoineFirstGeneration. Every certified claim has clean axioms. The docstring marks and the report are honest: Antoine stays stated and unmarked. The van Kampen theorem is correctly stated and sorry-free. The residual is true, so the sorry-free reduction from every generation to the first is real progress, not a vacuous one. Two major issues block a clean verdict. DEC-85's goal is unmet: `chain` is open, though its finite dihedral covering is identified. And the one sorry also covers five routine fields that should be proved separately. The minor issues are a stale declaration name in the VanKampen docstring, stale 'rests on' docstrings, bold marks on conditional declarations, duplicate report entries and the scaffold-to-scaffold import.
